factual_cards.linear_tabular: Registered linear_text adapter supports numeric/category-only frames. It fits median imputation, with_mean=False scaling and sparse OHE with unknown ignored; regression Ridge alpha10/lsqr, classification logistic C clipped .01..100 or SGD. Card names the actual engine and these existing settings accurately.
factual_cards.linear_text: Same adapter adds fitting-only TF-IDF and optional character/SVD transforms when actual text_features are present. Text/nontext card choice does not invent dedicated ridge/logistic keys.
factual_cards.extra_trees: Actual frequency category conversion and numeric fitting-median fill verified in prepare_frames; no early stopping, and HPO search_space supports only LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost.
factual_cards.validation_and_preparation: Instructions preserve fitting-only learned preprocessing, declared evaluator/partitions, strong control, resource/CSV/refit gates. They add no admission authority or quality measurement.
